worldcombat.skill.wonderroom.summary: Raises a swapping space on the chosen ground: bodies standing inside have their Defence and Sp. Def exchanged. Both sides are treated alike, and stepping out restores you at once.
worldcombat.skill.wonderroom.use.0: Hand a physical wall to a special attacker to break
worldcombat.skill.wonderroom.use.1: Let a special wall take physical hits
worldcombat.skill.wonderroom.use.2: Scramble the foe's read on your defences
worldcombat.skill.wonderroom.description: Raises a space of radius %2$s blocks on the chosen ground, lasting %1$s.
The current cast range is %1$s blocks; the space applies to both sides alike.
Raising the space takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the form note for the wide/compact trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.wonderroom.span.0: Wide: radius x1.2 and duration x1.15 (wider, longer), at +2 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.wonderroom.span.1: Compact: radius x0.85 and duration x0.8 (smaller, shorter), in exchange for x0.85 cooldown and no extra wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.wonderroom.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to raise the space, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
Wide: radius x1.2, duration x1.15, +2 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown — good to hold the main line for a long time. Compact: radius x0.85, duration x0.8, x0.85 cooldown — good for moving often and swapping only at your feet.
The companion only considers the wonder room while a threat is within this distance; lower presses it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the space at the foe
On, the space is pressed between you and the threat so the fighting line is swapped too; off, it is pressed at your feet to swap yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to raise the space.
world_combat.move.wonderroom.text.swap: Defence and Sp. Def trade places
worldcombat.skill.wonderroom.description: A body standing inside has its Defence and Sp. Def swapped, snapping back the moment it steps out or the space ends; only bodies that carry both stats are affected.
